# The Standard (Evening Standard)

> > The Standard is London's leading digital news source covering breaking news, sport, business, culture and lifestyle with live updates on events affecting the capital and beyond.

The Standard (formerly Evening Standard) is a major London-based news organization delivering comprehensive coverage of local, national and international news. The site features live coverage of major events, breaking news alerts, and in-depth analysis across news, sports, business, culture and lifestyle categories.

## Key Topics

- London news
- Breaking news
- Premier League
- Live updates
- Politics
- World news
- Transport
- Public health
- Football transfers
- Business/City desk
- Culture & arts
- Lifestyle
- Property market
- Live scores
- Celebrity news

## News & Breaking News

- [Homepage](https://www.standard.co.uk): Homepage for The Standard with London news, sport, culture and entertainment
- [News Hub](https://www.standard.co.uk/news): Main news hub covering London, UK and world breaking news and updates
- [London News](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/london): London news hub with breaking updates, crime, transport and local events
- [World News](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world): International breaking news and features covering global events and analysis
- [Iran missile attack on UK-US Diego Garcia military base raises fears London could be within striking distance](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world/iran-fires-ballistic-missiles-at-ukus-base-on-diego-garcia-b1275896.html): Breaking coverage of Iran ballistic missile attack on Diego Garcia base
- [London protests LIVE: Police brace as huge crowds rally against Iran war in central London](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/london/london-iran-stop-the-war-coalition-march-met-police-b1275909.html): Live coverage of London anti-war protests and Stop the War Coalition march

## Sport & Live Scores

- [Sport Hub](https://www.standard.co.uk/sport): Sports hub with live scores, Premier League, football and multi-sport coverage
- [Football](https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/football): Football hub with live scores, transfers, fixtures and Premier League coverage
- [Brighton vs Liverpool LIVE: Premier League result, latest updates and fan reaction](https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/football/brighton-vs-liverpool-fc-live-stream-latest-score-updates-result-premier-league-b1275912.html): Live Premier League match coverage of Brighton vs Liverpool with updates

## Business & Property

- [Business](https://www.standard.co.uk/business): Business news, City desk coverage, FTSE and market updates from Standard
- [Homes & Property](https://www.standard.co.uk/homesandproperty): London property market news, house prices, mortgages and area guides

## Culture, Lifestyle & Entertainment

- [Culture](https://www.standard.co.uk/culture): Culture and arts coverage including theatre, film, TV, music and exhibitions
- [Lifestyle](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle): Lifestyle hub with travel, fashion, beauty, wellness and celebrity content
- [Going Out](https://www.standard.co.uk/going-out): Restaurant reviews, bars, nightlife and London things to do guide
- [Health & Fitness](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle/health): Health and fitness hub with wellness tips, diet advice and health trends
- [Is the UK in the grip of a steroid epidemic?](https://www.standard.co.uk/lifestyle/health/uk-steroid-epidemic-b1275763.html): Investigation into UK steroid use and performance-enhancing drugs epidemic

## Health & Public Health

- [Health](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/health): Health news hub covering NHS updates, vaccines and public health stories
- [Meningitis cases rise to 34 as health experts continue to investigate outbreak](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/health/meningitis-outbreak-cases-b1275903.html): Health news on meningitis outbreak in Kent University with 34 confirmed cases

## Opinion & Commentary

- [Comment](https://www.standard.co.uk/comment): Opinion columns, commentary and analysis from Standard writers and editors
- [Fresh turmoil for Liz Truss as her £500,000 Mayfair private members' club delayed again](https://www.standard.co.uk/news/politics/liz-truss-mayfair-private-members-club-leconsfield-b1275681.html): Political news on Liz Truss and Leconfield private members club in Mayfair
